s00-01-story-ff1fcc.wav.text: There's a book in the Bible with no miracles in it.

s00-02-story-7e10d7.wav.text: No sea splits. No fire falls.

s00-03-story-43eeab.wav.text: Just a widow, picking up leftover grain in a field.

s01-01-story-3c9c6c.wav.text: In a famine, Naomi's family left Bethlehem for the land of Moab.

s01-02-story-08be7c.wav.text: Her two sons married Moabite women, Orpah and Ruth.

s01-04-story-66e80a.wav.text: And both her sons. Naomi had lost everything.

s01-05-story-e9318b.wav.text: She decided to go home, and told her daughters-in-law to go back to their own families.

s02-01-story-7751a1.wav.text: Orpah kissed her goodbye, and went back.

s02-03-grave-0eaaf0.wav.text: Where you go I will go, and where you lodge I will lodge.

s02-04-grave-477846.wav.text: Your people shall be my people, and your God my God.

s02-06-story-a41396.wav.text: She had nothing to gain. She chose Naomi, and Naomi's God.

s03-01-story-7f61a9.wav.text: They arrived in Bethlehem at the barley harvest.

s03-02-story-729fa8.wav.text: Ruth went out to glean, picking up what the reapers left behind.

s03-03-grave-001cb3.wav.text: And she happened to come to the part of the field belonging to Boaz.

s03-04-story-2f4211.wav.text: Boaz was a relative of Naomi's husband.

s03-05-story-4f9053.wav.text: He'd heard what Ruth had done for Naomi.

s03-06-story-8ce53c.wav.text: So he told his workers to drop extra grain for her, on purpose.

s04-02-story-3e1732.wav.text: In Israel, a close relative could redeem a widow's family: buy back their land, and marry her,

s04-03-story-a89b77.wav.text: so the family name wouldn't die.

s04-04-story-b7b00c.wav.text: So Ruth went to Boaz at night on the threshing floor, and asked him.

s04-05-grave-d9624d.wav.text: Spread your wings over your servant, for you are a redeemer.

s05-01-story-2f6955.wav.text: Boaz did it properly, in front of the elders at the town gate.

s06-02-story-ddf38b.wav.text: And the women of Bethlehem said, Naomi has a son again.

s06-04-grave-d838f7.wav.text: He was the father of Jesse, the father of David.

s07-02-story-778851.wav.text: Just loyal love, and a God who was there all along, in a field, in a famine, in a widow's grief.

s07-03-pivot-2547cb.wav.text: And from that family, centuries later, in that same town of Bethlehem, came Jesus.
